parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures come from the consolidated non-GAAP results summary for the second quarter. The excerpt does not include the reconciliation table. Its units are inferred as millions, consistent with the release's other tables stated in millions. Segment Adjusted EBITDA figures (HST, FMT, FSDP) are excluded. The IEEPA tariff impact amounts of $7.3 million are excluded because they are impacts, not totals. No six-month consolidated Adjusted EBITDA total is shown in the excerpt.
